import json, subprocess, sys
cases = [
  # (line bytes, expected)
  (b'{"op":"replay"}', "E_SCHEMA"),
  (b'{"op":"bogus","inputs":[[[1]]]}', "E_SCHEMA"),
  (b'{"inputs":[[[1]]]}', "E_SCHEMA"),
  (b'{"op":"replay","inputs":[[[1]]],"slots":0,"window":1,"events":[]}', "E_LIMIT"),
  (b'{"op":"replay","inputs":[[[1]]],"slots":1,"window":2,"events":[]}', "E_LIMIT"),
  (b'{"op":"replay","inputs":[[[1]]],"slots":17,"window":1,"events":[]}', "E_LIMIT"),
  (b'{"op":"replay","inputs":[[[1]]],"slots":1,"window":1,"events":[["send",0,5]]}', "E_LIMIT"),
  (b'{"op":"replay","inputs":[[[1]]],"slots":1,"window":1,"events":[["send",5,0]]}', "E_LIMIT"),
  (b'{"op":"replay","inputs":[[[1]]],"slots":1,"window":1,"events":[["send",0]]}', "E_SCHEMA"),
  (b'{"op":"replay","inputs":[[[1]],[[1,2]]],"slots":1,"window":1,"events":[]}', "E_SCHEMA"),
  (b'{"op":"replay","inputs":[[[1]]],"slots":1,"window":1,"events":[],"extra":1}', "E_SCHEMA"),
  (b'{"op":"replay","inputs":[[[true]]],"slots":1,"window":1,"events":[]}', "E_SCHEMA"),
  (b'{"op":"replay","inputs":[[[2000000000]]],"slots":1,"window":1,"events":[]}', "E_LIMIT"),
  (b'{"op":"replay","inputs":[],"slots":1,"window":1,"events":[]}', "E_LIMIT"),
  (b'{"op":"replay","inputs":[[[1]]],"slots":1,"window":1,"events":[["deliver",200001]]}', "E_LIMIT"),
  (b'{"op":"replay","inputs":[[[1]]],"slots":1,"window":1,"events":[["bogus",0]]}', "E_SCHEMA"),
  (b'{"op":"replay","inputs":[[[1]]],"slots":1,"window":1,"events":[["retry",0,0]]}', "E_SCHEMA"),
  (b'{"op":"replay","inputs":[[[1]]],"slots":1,"window":1,"events":{}}', "E_SCHEMA"),
  (b'{"op":"replay","inputs":[[[1]]],"slots":"1","window":1,"events":[]}', "E_SCHEMA"),
  (b'{"op":"replay","inputs":[[[1]]],"slots":1.0,"window":1,"events":[]}', "E_SCHEMA"),
  (b'{bad json', "E_JSON"),
  (b'{"op":"replay","inputs":[[[1]]],"slots":1,"window":1,"slots":2,"events":[]}', "E_JSON"),
  (b'{"op":"replay","inputs":[[[NaN]]],"slots":1,"window":1,"events":[]}', "E_JSON"),
  (b'{"op":"replay","inputs":[[[Infinity]]],"slots":1,"window":1,"events":[]}', "E_JSON"),
  (b'{"op":"replay","inputs":[[[1e400]]],"slots":1,"window":1,"events":[]}', "E_JSON"),
  (b'   ', "E_JSON"),
  (b'', "E_JSON"),
  (b'[1,2]', "E_SCHEMA"),
  (b'5', "E_SCHEMA"),
  (b'{"op":"replay","inputs":[[[1]]],"slots":1,"window":1,"events":[]}\x80', "E_JSON"),
  # audit cases
  (b'{"op":"audit","inputs":[[[1]]],"states":[{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[]}],"edges":[[0,"a",0],[0,"a",0]],"start":0,"fairness":[]}', "E_SCHEMA"),
  (b'{"op":"audit","inputs":[[[1]]],"states":[{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[]}],"edges":[],"start":0,"fairness":[{"action":"a","mode":"weak"},{"action":"a","mode":"strong"}]}', "E_SCHEMA"),
  (b'{"op":"audit","inputs":[[[1]]],"states":[{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[{"seq":0,"ranks":[],"sum":[0]},{"seq":0,"ranks":[],"sum":[0]}]}],"edges":[],"start":0,"fairness":[]}', "E_SCHEMA"),
  (b'{"op":"audit","inputs":[[[1]]],"states":[{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[{"seq":0,"ranks":[0,0],"sum":[0]}]}],"edges":[],"start":0,"fairness":[]}', "E_SCHEMA"),
  (b'{"op":"audit","inputs":[[[1]]],"states":[],"edges":[],"start":0,"fairness":[]}', "E_LIMIT"),
  (b'{"op":"audit","inputs":[[[1]]],"states":[{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[]}],"edges":[],"start":5,"fairness":[]}', "E_LIMIT"),
  (b'{"op":"audit","inputs":[[[1]]],"states":[{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[]}],"edges":[],"start":0,"fairness":[{"action":"a","mode":"medium"}]}', "E_SCHEMA"),
  (b'{"op":"audit","inputs":[[[1]]],"states":[{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[]}],"edges":[],"start":0,"fairness":[{"action":"1bad","mode":"weak"}]}', "E_SCHEMA"),
  (b'{"op":"audit","inputs":[[[1]]],"states":[{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[]}],"edges":[],"start":0,"fairness":[{"action":"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa","mode":"weak"}]}', "E_LIMIT"),
  (b'{"op":"audit","inputs":[[[1]]],"states":[{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[]}],"edges":[],"start":0,"fairness":[{"action":"a","mode":"weak","x":1}]}', "E_SCHEMA"),
  (b'{"op":"audit","inputs":[[[1]]],"states":[{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[{"seq":0,"ranks":[0],"sum":[0]}]}],"edges":[],"start":0,"fairness":[]}', "E_LIMIT"),
  (b'{"op":"audit","inputs":[[[1]]],"states":[{"delivered":[[[1]]],"slots":[]}],"edges":[],"start":0,"fairness":[]}', "E_LIMIT"),
  (b'{"op":"audit","inputs":[[[1]]],"states":[{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[]}],"edges":[],"start":0,"fairness":[],"x":1}', "E_SCHEMA"),
  (b'{"op":"audit","inputs":[[[1]]],"states":[{"delivered":[[]],"slots":[]}],"edges":[[0,"a",1]],"start":0,"fairness":[]}', "E_LIMIT"),
]
data = b"\n".join(c[0] for c in cases) + b"\n"
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "/app/submission/main.py"], input=data, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
lines = p.stdout.splitlines()
if p.stderr: print("STDERR:", p.stderr.decode()[:2000])
assert len(lines) == len(cases), (len(lines), len(cases))
bad = 0
for (raw, exp), line in zip(cases, lines):
    got = json.loads(line)
    if got != {"error": exp}:
        bad += 1
        print("MISMATCH exp=%s got=%s  raw=%s" % (exp, got, raw[:110]))
print("error cases:", len(cases), "mismatches:", bad)
PYEOF
